                                if grid[y][x] == grid[yy][xx]:

                        score = matches / count
                        # Resolve equally good alignments by favoring nearby
                        # positions and the same row/column.
                        tie = (abs(r - rr) + abs(c - cc),
                               0 if r == rr or c == cc else 1)
                        if (score > best_score or

                            best = ((rr, cc), tie)
